item.title: Thales to supply Ground Master radars to Poland & reinforce the European Sky Shield Initiative
item.description: Thales will supply Ground Master 400 air surveillance radars to the Polish Armed Forces, contributing to the European Sky Shield Initiative. Deliveries start in 2027.

item.title: Thales opens a satellite payload integration hall
item.description: Thales Alenia Space opened a new integration hall for telecommunications satellite payloads to increase production capacity.
